answer: An identity must be at least 3 epochs old on the quill ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the delta checkpoint rather than self-declared, the signal audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm as a result means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. That is 20 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
